background: SMBC Bank International is the London-based bank of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, serving the Japanese group's corporate and institutional clients across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, funded by corporate deposits and the parent.
synthesis: The bank is rated A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 8 Dec 2022, and the grades rest on the Japanese parent. Capital is strong against UK mid-sized banks, with CET1 of 16.6% and leverage of 7.7% both above the peer medians. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 152% in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 128% below the peer median, and since 31 Dec 2024 leverage has fallen 1.5 points, LCR 10 points and NSFR 6 points, with the figures running to 31 Dec 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
